name: society-mgmt-300k
description: Ajit-backprop-test - test project for backprop integration (society_mgmt_300k synthetic fixture).

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'),path=require('path');let n=0;const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(p.endsWith('.js')){cp.execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',p],{stdio:['ignore','ignore','inherit']});n++;}});walk('src');console.log('build OK: node --check passed for '+n+' src JS files');"
